text_block_list.text:
One day, while visiting the shopping 
district――

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All right! Discount protein bars, secured!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, thank you for catching my 
balloon!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome! Don't let go of it 
again, okay?

It seemed Ines Fujin was putting her 
signature explosive speed to good use even 
inside the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: *waaah*, Ines-chaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hello-hello~? Didn't you say today 
was your first date?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But he hasn't shown up at all, no 
matter how long I wait.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
He hasn't even read my messages... Did 
something happen to him?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I thought about going to his place, but I 
can't bring myself to do it when I think 
about what if he just stood me up...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If you wait, he might come, but he 
might not either.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why, when in doubt, it's best to 
muster your courage and just go!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Even if by some rare chance something did 
happen to him, if you hurry, you can still 
make it in time!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I'm gonna go! Thank you, 
Ines-chan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Good luck! Everything's gonna be just 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Because you'll definitely make it in 
time. Both you, and me――
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! You're... from Tracen Academy, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What I said just now was, uhh... How 
should I put it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Back then, whenever I was lost and 
hesitant, someone gave me a push on the 
back, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
She reminded me so much of how I used to 
be, so I couldn't help but meddle a bit.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Just waiting around won't open up a path. 
That's why she—and I—have to keep moving 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eyes fixed ahead, faster than anyone else. 
...Stepping out powerfully right from the 
very first stride!

Ines Fujin's resolute words and gaze 
filled me with courage just watching her.
